target.title: fix(snapshot): store UISnapshot target cache in OSAllocatedUnfairLock
target.body:
## Summary

`UISnapshot` stored app/window cache fields as `nonisolated(unsafe)` written from actor-isolated methods and read from `nonisolated` computed properties. That bypasses the actor executor for the cache.

This PR moves the cache into `OSAllocatedUnfairLock` so nonisolated readers and actor writers share a lock-backed `Sendable` state.

## Failure scenario

1. One isolation domain updates `setScreenshot` / `setTargetMetadata`.
2. Another reads `applicationName` / `windowTitle` / `applicationProcessId` concurrently via nonisolated accessors.
3. Unfixed: data race on the three cached properties.

## Verification

- `swift build --target PeekabooAgentRuntime` → complete

## Scope

`UISnapshot` target cache only. Snapshot manager retention logic is unchanged.
